description: This file defines the 'Featured' controller class for the OpenCart admin module, handling display, save, add, and delete operations for a featured products module in the admin interface.

classes.name: Featured
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Featured module in OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the featured module configuration page, loading necessary data and views.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the featured module configuration, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new featured module instance.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an existing featured module instance.
